entries.4883f4576b6651eb: Drive and Measurement Control Systems and FA Systems
entries.5aa9658ecf1d3e4d: This business covers facilities that generate electricity and facilities that distribute and stabilize the electricity produced. It handles thermal, geothermal and hydroelectric power generation equipment, fuel cells and nuclear-related equipment, as well as substation and receiving equipment, industrial power supply equipment, power storage systems, energy management systems, solar and wind power generation, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), electrical panels, and electrical and air-conditioning construction work. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥385,260 million and segment profit was ¥59,506 million, the second largest by revenue but the largest of the four reportable segments by profit. The number of employees was 6,965, excluding 608 temporary employees. In the segment reorganization at the start of the current fiscal year, the equipment construction field was incorporated into this segment, and the company explains that this was aimed at strengthening its systems business. The annual securities report attributes a steady rise in capital expenditure by power, manufacturing and data center operators to GX investment aimed at realizing a decarbonized society and to rising energy demand from the expanded use of generative AI and digital technologies. The order intake of FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD.'s Energy division on a standalone basis was ¥331.1 billion.
entries.675d5b8601601a2b: This field sells components that equipment makers incorporate into their own machines. Items include inverters, motors, servo systems, small power supplies, measuring instruments, sensors, smart meters, controllers and HMIs. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit (loss) exceeded the prior year, mainly due to higher demand for measuring instruments.
entries.84d1923df9d48e1f: This field handles ICT-related equipment and software. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit (loss) exceeded the prior year due to an increase in large projects in the education sector, and the company cites the increase in large projects in this field as the main factor behind overall growth in the Industry segment.
entries.86aa1daff1deb964: Thermal, Geothermal and Hydroelectric Power Generation Equipment
entries.9a909088a7d09a0b: This business uses electricity to power, measure and control factories, railways, ships and other “moving things and production sites.” It handles components such as inverters, motors, servo systems, measuring instruments, sensors, smart meters, controllers and HMIs, as well as drive and measurement control systems that combine them, drive and door systems for railway vehicles, power receiving, distribution and control equipment, and ICT-related equipment and software. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥464,353 million, the largest of the four reportable segments; segment profit was ¥44,383 million, and the number of employees was 10,856, excluding 1,054 temporary employees. Revenue from external customers rose sharply from ¥396,679 million in the prior year, and the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] attributes this mainly to an increase in large IT solutions projects. Following a segment reorganization at the start of the current fiscal year, the Equipment field, which had been separate until then, was incorporated into this segment. The company explains that this was aimed at creating synergies with FA components. The order intake of FUJI ELECTRIC CO.,LTD.'s Industry division on a standalone basis was ¥185.2 billion.
entries.a64a7eb335d4205d: A Kawasaki-based electrical equipment manufacturer that makes a wide range of equipment handling electricity, from power generation equipment to factory inverters, power semiconductors and vending machines.
entries.b9765733a9cfcb0d: This field does not sell individual components but delivers systems that operate factory equipment as a whole. It handles drive and measurement control systems and FA systems. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit (loss) exceeded the prior year, due to higher demand from the steel sector.
entries.c4eaae9af58eb59d: Power Receiving, Distribution and Control Equipment
entries.c691ec1c71922fc4: This field handles drive systems and door systems for railway vehicles, systems for ships and ports, and radiation equipment and systems. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, both revenue and operating profit (loss) exceeded the prior year, due to higher demand for transportation systems.
entries.eb4c3bd83e5283c4: This field handles power receiving, distribution and control equipment, and was incorporated into Industry in the current segment reorganization. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue rose above the prior year as demand from machinery set makers recovered gradually, and operating profit (loss) also exceeded the prior year, as higher demand and price revisions offset the impact of soaring raw material prices.
